svg.title: Genome-wide copy number — Colorectal, Breast
svg.text: Share of each cohort's segmented SAMPLES (not patients: a patient with two segmented samples counts twice) gained (log2 segment mean ≥ 0.2) or lost (≤ −0.2) in each
2 Mb bin, hg19. Each bin's denominator is the samples whose segmentation covers it; a bin takes the value of the segment over its midpoint, so an event narrower than 2
Mb can be missed — use a smaller binMb to find it. 12,079 of 12,084 samples have segments. Thresholds on a log ratio are not purity- or ploidy-corrected: a low-purity
tumour's real loss can sit inside ±0.2. Chromosome X is not drawn (includeX: true adds it). Per-bin two-sided Fisher tests, Benjamini–Hochberg across bins separately for
gains and losses; adjacent bins are not independent, so read a run of significant bins as one region, not many findings.
